title: Too Many Drops

patient.name: Mr Tan Hock Seng
patient.presenting_complaint: On several eye drops for glaucoma and dry eye — confused about how to use them together

history.hpc: Mr Tan says 'I got so many bottles, I just put one after another, correct or not?' He is on a glaucoma drop and a lubricant and is unsure about timing and order.
history.pmhx: Glaucoma on topical treatment; dry eye. No drug allergies (confirm).

examination_findings.anterior_segment: No active infection that would change technique
examination_findings.fundus: Not the focus of this station

investigations.task: Instil the charted drops correctly and teach the patient to space multiple drops and use the correct order
investigations.key_points: Wait about 5 minutes between different drops so the first is not washed out; instil the more important (e.g. glaucoma) drop first if charted; one drop is enough per dose

diagnosis: Multiple drops instilled and explained: the patient is taught to leave about 5 minutes between different drops so they are not washed out, to use one drop per dose, and to follow the charted order. Identity, correct eye and allergy are confirmed and a no-touch technique is used. This is a procedural/teaching station.

immediate: Confirm identity, the correct eye(s) and each charted drop and strength
Check for drug/eye-drop allergy before instilling
Perform hand hygiene and instil one drop into the lower fornix with a no-touch technique
Leave about 5 minutes before instilling a different drop so it is not washed out
Use one drop per dose and follow the charted order
Apply gentle closure / nasolacrimal pressure after each
Document the drops given, eye, time and allergy check
follow_up: Give the patient a simple written schedule for home
Advise reporting stinging, allergy or worsening symptoms
patient_education: Explain one drop is enough — more just overflows
Teach spacing different drops by a few minutes
Advise keeping a routine and not running out of glaucoma drops

key_points: Confirms identity, correct eye and each charted drop
Explains the plan and gains cooperation
Instils one drop per dose into the lower fornix (no-touch)
Spaces different drops by about 5 minutes
Understands why drops must be spaced (wash-out)
Knows one drop per dose is sufficient
Recognises adherence to glaucoma drops as important
Documents drops, eye, time and allergy check
Educates on spacing and one-drop dosing
